title: What's New: Contoso Demo Tool (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Problems with the old demo data approach

features.name: Modular demo data architecture
features.description: Breaking down monolithic demo packages into independent modules following namespaces in Business Central, with support for dependencies among modules.

features.name: Code-based demo data definition
features.description: Demo data defined as code in codeunits instead of file-based packages, making it easier to read, maintain, extend, and integrate with source control.

features.name: Translation support in demo data
features.description: Using translation files to handle translations in demo data the same way as in applications, instead of maintaining multiple versions of packages.

features.name: GitHub repository for demo tool
features.description: The demo tool code and data generation scripts are available in a GitHub app extensions repository for inspection, contribution, and community feedback.
caveats: Currently in GitHub, future plan is to move to BC apps and open source

features.name: Layered demo data structure
features.description: Breaking down modules into separate layers: setup data, master data, and historical transactions, allowing independent development and expansion of each layer.

features.name: Dynamic historical data calculation
features.description: Historical data can be coded to automatically adjust based on current dates, such as keeping posted documents within the same fiscal quarter regardless of when the demo is performed.
